What depends on a stored model, repository or dataset

Source: R/save-objects.R
list_dependents.Rd

Lists the store entries that reference x rather than embedding a copy: those that would break if it were deleted. For models and repositories the dependents recorded on their sealed versions are verified (does the dependent still exist, does it still reference that version) and, with recursive = TRUE, followed through models to the scenarios using them; references found in the manifests are added (the only record for datasets, and for references saved before versions recorded their dependents). This is the check unseal_model() / unseal_repository() make before releasing a name.

Usage

list_dependents(
  x,
  type = NULL,
  version = NULL,
  recursive = FALSE,
  prune = FALSE,
  details = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

an energyRt object, or the name of a store entry.

type

the entry type when x is a bare name: "model", "repository", "dataset" or "scenario".

version

optional hash (or prefix) of one version.

recursive

logical; follow dependents that are themselves sealed versions (repository -> models -> scenarios).

prune

logical; remove the records of x's own versions whose dependent no longer exists or no longer references them.

details

logical; TRUE returns every column and also the stale records (exists / references FALSE).

Value

a tibble: level (1 = references x directly), the dependent's type, name and path, the version it references and whether that is x's current one; with details also of_type, of_name, hash (the dependent's own), exists, references and via.

See also

list_versions(), delete_marked(), mark_delete()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
list_dependents("TOPIA", type = "model")            # which scenarios use it
list_dependents("my_repo", type = "repository", recursive = TRUE)
} # }
